description: Frozen per-model budget for automatic daily requalification (04:00 checkpoint). A route enters the requalification set once its remaining TTL drops into the final 24h window, is expired, or is degraded; a successful pass refreshes validity to a fresh 168h. Two budget classes: (1) priced providers — frozen_max_cost_cny derived from qualification_completion_call_count (model-extension-runbook §7) times the then-current list price, never auto-increased; (2) subscription/relay providers without a public per-token list price — frozen_max_cost_cny is null and the frozen max_completion_calls count IS the budget (no CNY figure is invented for Credits or console-walled relay pricing). requalify_due.py enforces membership fail-closed: any due route without an entry aborts the whole run.
